name: spellkave_stow_item
label: Stow Item (verb)
description: sk-9ll.3: place an already-authored entity inside a container (entity_containment, upsert-by-entity_key — a re-authored containment MOVES the entity, mirroring add-entity-containment's own upsert semantics). Folds the 'starter pack straight into the hero' / 'item straight onto its holder' idiom (container_entity_key omitted, defaults to actor_entity_key) AND the nested-container idiom (container_entity_key explicit, e.g. a torch into an already-stowed field kit) into one checked call, replacing a raw spellkave_write_rows entity_containment call.

bundle.description: bundle_id stamped on the generated row. Omit to fall back to `context.defaultBundle` (#1968 smart default).

actor_entity_key.description: The actor stowing item_entity_key — must already carry an actor_spatial_locations row (workspace, live, or the active target); place it first via spellkave_place_actor. Also the DEFAULT container when container_entity_key is omitted. Omit it to put an item into a placed container with no actor involved (a potion in a chest): then container_entity_key is required.

item_entity_key.description: entity_containment.entity_key — an already-placed entity (workspace or the active target) to move into container_entity_key (or actor_entity_key when container_entity_key is omitted).

container_entity_key.description: entity_containment.container_entity_key. Default actor_entity_key — the common 'give the actor this item directly' case (a starter weapon straight into the hero's inventory). Pass a DIFFERENT already-placed container (e.g. a field kit already stowed on the actor) to nest item_entity_key inside IT instead (the torch-inside-the-field-kit idiom).

slot_id.description: entity_containment.slot_id — machine-port slot id. Default '' (loose carriage — the common item-in-backpack/actor-holding-item case, not a machine port).
